title: Dr Arvind Panagariya Inaugurates Prem Ratan Shah Memorial Government Girls' School in Kalandri, Rajasthan
summary: A new government girls' senior secondary school in Kalandri, Sirohi, developed by the Government of Rajasthan with RK Trust, was inaugurated on 22 November 2026.
body_html:
Kalandri, 22 November 2026: The Prem Ratan Shah Memorial Government Girls’ Senior Secondary School in Kalandri, Sirohi district, Rajasthan, was inaugurated on 22 November 2026 by Dr Arvind Panagariya, Padma Bhushan awardee, Chairman of the 16th Finance Commission of India, Chancellor of Nalanda University and Professor of Economics at Columbia University. The school has been developed by the Government of Rajasthan in partnership with RK Trust.

Dr Shobha Vartaman, Indian anaesthesiologist and humanitarian, also attended the ceremony. The new school aims to widen access to quality education for girls in Kalandri and the surrounding areas.

The campus has been planned as a modern, child-friendly learning environment, with infrastructure suited to the local climate, technology-enabled classrooms, teacher training, sports facilities and scholarship support. It currently has about 350 students on its rolls and has been designed to accommodate up to 1,000 students at a time. Students of the former Sree Mahavir Government Girls Senior Secondary School have moved to the new campus.

Architecturally, the buildings use compressed stabilised earth blocks, passive cooling techniques, shaded outdoor spaces, rainwater harvesting and solar energy. Shaded corridors and courtyards have been designed for play, group activities, outdoor learning and informal interaction, and are intended to serve as community spaces after school hours.

The initiative draws on the Shah family’s tradition of service and RK Trust’s work in education, and is guided by the message: "Educate a girl. Empower a community. Enable a generation."

Speaking at the inauguration, Dr Arvind Panagariya said, “My entire life stands on the foundation of education. That is why I believe there is no greater means in this world to move forward in life than education.”

Mr. RK Shah, Chairman, RK Trust, said, “Having my roots in Kalandri, this school is very close to my heart. It has always been my dream to create better opportunities for the people of my village. I strongly believe that educating a girl not only shapes her future but also strengthens her family and the entire community. I hope this school gives every girl the confidence and opportunity to dream big and become who she wishes to be. Seeing this dream take shape is a matter of great happiness for me.”

The ceremony also saw the unveiling of the book “Footprints of Faith: In Search of Jain Heritage in Pakistan”, authored by Sandipan Deb, by Dr Shobha Vartaman.
